qt: to the Commission Costas Mavrides (S&D) Subject:

In view of the EU’s strong condemnation of the provocative Turkish escalation with the legally null so-called Türkiye–Libya ‘Memorandum of Understanding on the delimitation of maritime jurisdiction areas’, a violation of international law, and considering the threats of war by Turkey against the EU and its projects in the Eastern Mediterranean, the situation in the region requires particular attention and an appropriate proactive response at EU level. It is therefore crucial that the EU safeguards its interests and its Member States’ sovereign rights, protects the freedom of navigation and lawful maritime activities, and contributes to regional stability and security. In the light of the above, the Commission is asked: Does it intend, in cooperation with the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, to support and promote the establishment of an EU military mission under the Common Security and Defence Policy in the Eastern Mediterranean, to safeguard freedom of navigation, protect maritime security and contribute to regional stability, with a view to a decision by the Council?
